entry_contract.lesson_copy: Localized core lesson text. This makes the relationship-first lesson usable from the learner's source language without requiring a bespoke source-target lesson.
entry_contract.terms: A localized beginner-facing label for every canonical relationship concept. Labels may be multiword descriptions when the language has no single broad lexeme.
entry_contract.game_terms: Target-language candidate forms for recognition/matching games. Rich profiles may replace a broad candidate with conditioned variants.
entry_contract.translation_state: Machine translations remain machine_translated until reviewed; structural completeness never self-promotes linguistic trust.

selection_policy: Source language and target language are independent. Join source lesson_copy and concept labels with the target language's game terms or rich profile at runtime.
